r10-cp-cross--cp-judge-jury: A judge ruling on a summary judgment motion may not draw fact inferences or weigh credibility; those tasks belong to the jury or other trier of fact.

r10-cp-cross--cp-burden-production: The rule that bare pleadings cannot defeat a supported motion does not shift the burden to the nonmovant when the movant's showing rests entirely on the credibility of his own witnesses.
